verdict.rationale: Gide is a law firm, but it states that it uses AI in delivering its services, so asking whether client data can be kept out of AI training is a fair question. The evidence pack has no documented opt-out, no data-use policy, and no commitment on model training. The GDPR advisory practice is legal advice offered to clients, not a control over how Gide handles client data, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
